unit: dsdv_svc_rs (x16, 2 x 8 grid; sid 9 = dsdv_svc_rs_root, the host endpoint)
form: CLUSTER of hardened leaves; the slice top is NOT kitted. Every leaf below is hardened once and replicated.

leaves.role: D=32 attention share (ot_hdc_v41x_attn_s D=TD=32, NL 4, S=1) + 2-PC service: OWN_ROW/host writes, window + scale reads, owned-row fetch, slot-addressed landing 640 x 256 b, q 16 x 512 b, p 512 x 512 b

leaves.state: sx_row kit + local gate PASS (S81U-SVCX); relays closed
leaves.role: q.k balanced 16-tile tree node, scatter, SM-head tap

leaves.module: ot_s81_su_sms = s81su_smq + dsfd_su_t_smh (4 x dsfd_su_t_smhq + dsfd_su_t_smhr)
leaves.state: smq APPROVED; smhq/smhr kits + local gates WARN 0 fail (S81U-SMH2)

leaves.role: dn stream tree (805 b: q 513 + hw 292) and up tree (14 b: done, fault, 6 credits, 6 acks) pin flops + relays, SE row assembler (4 tap beats -> one 16-score row), SM row mux + collision fault, hs status sync; root only: ot_s81_svc_job gate, END result word, hc credits

port_cut.hbm: rq 2 x 341 out; rk, wd, rv 2 x 1, r_data 2 x 256, r_tag 2 x 17, r_beat 2 x 4, hs 2 in
port_cut.score_lanes_per_face_NESW: gather in/out 2,132 b + v, scatter in/out 1,076 b + v
port_cut.stream_lanes_per_face_NESW: dn in/out 805 b, up in/out 14 b
port_cut.pv: pv_v + pv_d 513 out (non-zero on the 4 slices of quarter ST)
port_cut.sm_face: w_v, w_a 14, w_m 16, w_d 512, w_st 12 out
port_cut.root_only: j 33 in, jd 2 out, q 515 in, hw 292 in, hc 9 out, fault out

static_schedule: no ready/credit on on-die paths; GO + compiled gd per slice (role ROM); landing checked at release (fault); HBM boundary elastic per owner 10-15. Caveat: the P.V p feed is paced by the closed engine's own p_ready (its loader runs <= LA blocks ahead of issue) -- deterministic, inherited from ot_s81_svch_attq, not arbitration.
